title: Five Winters and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 火灾安全 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 火灾安全（人与社会·灾害防范与安全）
meta: 主题语境：火灾安全（人与社会·灾害防范与安全）　|　核心词汇：exit　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 exit 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 my father ① found an exit that no warden in the hall would have marked, and he said the finding was the whole of the winter. The ② exit, meaning the door itself and not the stair, ran five winters and stayed unmarked in the book; an exit, he said, is the only thing in a hall that is judged by how long it is left unmarked.

Every ③ exit in that hall had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ exit at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the night and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An exit, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to mark; my father said the marking is the part that fills five winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the exit was the whole of the drill, meaning the leaving and not the door. The ⑥ exit, meaning the leaving and not any of that, is the only thing in a drill that everybody waits for and nobody marks; exit, he said, is either something you find or the only word that means both a door and a leaving. He said the leaving is the part they remember.

By 1967 the ⑦ exit had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ exit of the whole thing, my father wrote in January, was one hall and five winters of marking; exit, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to mark. He said the marking was never mentioned.

The ⑨ exit I remember is the one marked in the plan, which closed in 1969 and is still described as the quietest in the hall. An ⑩ exit, my mother said in 1971, is the only one that improves by being marked; every exit, she said, is a leaving that has agreed to look like a door. She said the leaving was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 出口；安全门（指大厅里每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 出口（指那一处本身，与楼梯相对）
C. 固定搭配：find an exit 找到一处出口
D. n. 出口（指留给夜班使用的那一处）
E. n. 出口（抽象总称，指一座大厅的安全门之事）
F. n. 出口（指示意图上写到、被标出的那一处）
G. n. 离开；退出（指一次演练里人人都等却无人标出的那样东西）
H. n. 离开（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人标出的那样东西）

answers.why: find an exit 意为“找到一处出口”，1962 年父亲找到了一处大厅里没有一位管理员肯标出的出口。
exit 意为“出口”，指那一处本身而不是楼梯，它经过了五个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
exit 意为“出口”，指大厅里每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一盏短短的灯。
exit 意为“出口”，指留给夜班使用的那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
exit 意为“离开、退出”，指一次演练里人人都等却无人标出的那样东西，叔叔说这次离开就是那次演练的全部。
exit 意为“离开”，指人人都等却无人标出的那样东西而不是那一处门，是演练里人人都等、却无人标出的东西。
exit 意为“出口”，指示意图上写到、被标出的那一处，到 1967 年这一处成了示意图里的一行。
exit 意为“出口”，父亲一月写道，整件事的安全门之事是一座大厅和五个冬天的标出。
exit 意为“出口”，我记得的是示意图上标出的那一处，1969 年关了，至今仍被说成大厅里最安静的一处。
exit 为抽象总称，母亲 1971 年说，一处出口是唯一会因为被好好标出而变得更好的东西。
